question: What is the maximum Energy I can have at once?
span: You can have a maximum of 6 Energy at once.

question: Can I spend zero Energy on an X cost card?
span: You can spend any amount of Energy when playing an X cost card, including 0.

question: When is a player's Block removed?
span: A player's Block is removed at the start of the Player Turn.

question: When is an enemy's Block removed?
span: An enemy's Block is removed at the start of the Enemy Turn.

question: Does Block stop an effect that says lose HP?
span: Block does not prevent "Lose X HP" effects.

question: What happens to Exhausted cards when combat ends?
span: Keep Exhausted cards in a separate pile and return them to your deck at the end of combat.

question: Is there a maximum hand size?
span: No, there is no maximum hand size.

question: Can Curses be Transformed?
span: Curses can't be Transformed.

question: Do copies of a card cost Energy?
span: Copies do not cost Energy to play.

question: Can a copy of a card itself be copied?
span: Copies cannot also be copied.

question: What is the maximum Block a player can have?
span: Block [Block] (Max 20 for players)

question: How many Vulnerable tokens can one enemy have?
span: up to a limit of 3 [Vulnerable] per player or enemy

question: How many Weak tokens can be applied to a target?
span: up to a limit of 3 [Weak] per player or enemy

question: Are Retained cards discarded at end of turn?
span: Retained cards are not discarded at the end of the Player Turn.

question: Can I reroll the die during the same round?
span: One die result determines all die effects for the round!

question: What happens when we run out of tokens?
span: If you run out of tokens, you can't gain or apply more tokens. The effect is ignored.

question: Do cards remember that they were Retained?
span: Cards have no memory once they leave your hand.

question: Do Summons flee when the enemy that summoned them dies?
span: No. Unlike the video game, Summons don't "flee" combat when the enemy that summoned them is killed.

question: Can I use Gambling Chip at an Event?
span: Yes. "Once per room" abilities can be used at Events if applicable.

question: Can the Watcher enter Stances using the Prismatic Shard?
span: The Watcher can't enter Stances on the Prismatic Shard.

question: What happens if an effect tries to play a card that cannot be played?
span: If an effect tries to play a card that can't be played, ignore the effect and discard that card instead.

question: Does an Ethereal card in my hand do anything at end of turn?
span: At end of turn, if this card is in your hand, Exhaust it.

question: Do Status and Daze cards stay in my deck after combat?
span: Remove these from your deck at the end of each combat.

question: Is the token limit shared between players?
span: The token limit remains the same, but it is shared between all players.

question: Do I remove Weak and Vulnerable tokens at the end of the round?
span: Nope. See back of rulebook for details.

question: What happens when my draw pile is empty and I need to draw?
span: When your draw pile is empty and you need to draw, your discard pile becomes the new draw pile.

question: How many cards do I draw at the start of my turn?
span: Draw 5 cards.

question: Can I discuss strategy with the other players?
span: Players can discuss strategy, such as which enemies to attack and which players need help.

question: In what order do I resolve a card's effects?
span: Execute the card's printed effects from top to bottom.

question: Where does a Power go after I play it?
span: If it's a Power, instead place it face up in front of you.

question: Can I play a card during the Enemy Turn?
span: Players can play cards, use potions, and activate abilities in any order they choose.

question: Can I look at another player's hand before deciding my play?
span: Players can discuss strategy, such as which enemies to attack and which players need help.

question: Can I choose not to draw my 5 cards at the start of turn?
span: Draw 5 cards.

question: Can I spend Energy after the End of Turn step has begun?
span: When players are done playing cards, the following effects occur:

question: What is the best Ironclad deck for Ascension 20?
How much does the retail edition of the game cost?
Which expansion adds the Watcher character?
If a card that draws me cards causes my discard pile to reshuffle into a new draw pile, does that card get shuffled in with the rest?
span: If a card was just played that drew you cards, that card is set aside while you shuffle, then added to the new discard pile.

question: Does an enemy's unused Block carry over into the next round?
span: Enemies lose all of their leftover Block [Block] tokens.

question: If playing a card triggers another ability partway through, does that ability resolve immediately or wait?
span: Any abilities triggered by the card don't take effect until after the card is finished resolving all of its text.

question: Can I discard my hand before the other players are finished playing their cards?
span: All players take these steps simultaneously.

question: If I already have 8 Strength and play a card that grants more Strength, do I gain the extra?
span: A player can have a maximum of 8 [Strength].

question: For a card that cares about cards "containing Strike," does a card need the literal word "Strike" printed in its name, or just deal Strike-type damage?
span: A card that "contains Strike" has the word "Strike" somewhere in its name.

question: When I Exhaust a Status card, does it go to my personal exhaust pile like other cards?
span: Daze [Daze] and Status [Status Green]/[Status Red] cards return to their respective piles when Exhausted.

question: Can I play a Shiv from my hand the way I'd play a normal card?
span: Shivs don't count as cards.

question: If I'm already at my 5-Shiv maximum and gain another Shiv, can I use it to deal damage immediately instead of losing it?
span: If you're out of Shiv tokens and you gain a Shiv [Shiv], you can deal Shiv damage immediately or skip gaining the Shiv.

question: Can Miracle tokens push my Energy above the normal 6 maximum?
span: You can use Miracles to go over the Energy limit (max 6) if they are immediately used to pay for a card.

question: Is the 30-Poison cap applied per enemy, or shared across every enemy in the fight?
span: There can't be more than 30 Poison [Poison] combined on all enemies.

question: Can I strip Poison tokens off an enemy before it dies to reduce the damage it'll eventually take?
span: Don't remove Poison [Poison] tokens from an enemy until they are dead.

question: Can Block reduce the HP loss dealt by Poison?
span: Losing HP ignores Block [Block] (Poison [Poison] doesn't deal damage).

question: If all of the Defect's Orb slots are full and I Channel another Orb, is the new Orb lost?
span: If you Channel an Orb and all Orb slots are full, Evoke any Orb, then place the Channeled Orb in its slot.

question: Do the Defect's Orbs rotate through slots and have to be Evoked front-to-back, like in the video game?
span: No, no, and no. You can Channel an Orb into *any* empty Orb slot, and you can Evoke *any* Orb you have. All Orb slots are treated the same.

question: Can the Watcher sit in Wrath Stance for the rest of combat without any downside?
span: If you end your turn in Wrath, take 1 damage.

question: If I'm already in Calm Stance, can I 're-enter' Calm to refresh an on-enter effect?
span: You cannot enter a Stance you are already in (the effect is ignored).

question: When multiple enemies share a row, do they act in a specific left-to-right order?
span: Starting with the highest row, enemies act left to right taking one action each.

question: Does the Boss ever act before the other enemies in a fight?
span: Bosses always act last.

question: Does the Gremlin Nob's Enraged ability affect its very first turn of combat?
span: The **Gremlin Nob**'s **Enraged** ability doesn't start until turn 2 of combat.

question: Do "Start of turn" abilities trigger during the Enemy Turn?
span: Note that the Enemy Turn doesn't have a "Start of Turn" phase.

question: Does "End of turn" ever refer to the end of the Enemy Turn?
span: The phrase "End of turn" is only used to refer to the end of the Player Turn (never the Enemy Turn).

question: If I already used a "Once per combat" relic ability this fight, can I use it again later in the same combat?
span: These abilities can only be used once per combat.

question: After I've already picked a card from a Card Reward, can I change my mind and swap it for one of the other two revealed cards?
span: After revealing cards or items, you can look at what the other rewards are from that combat before making any final decisions on what to choose or skip.

question: Can I hand a spare Relic to a teammate who could use it more?
span: Nothing else can be traded.

question: Can I pass a Potion to another player in the middle of combat?
span: Potions can be given to other players outside of combat.

question: Can I cover the gold cost of a teammate's Card Remove at the Merchant?
span: You can use your gold to pay for any amount of another player's purchase at a Merchant or Event.

question: Can I pay to remove a second card from my deck during the same Merchant visit?
span: Each player can only do this once per Merchant room.

question: If an Event asks me to "Give" something I don't currently have, can I still pick that option?
span: To choose a "Pay" or "Give" option, you must first have what it is asking you to pay or give.

question: Can two different players both choose the same bracketed option on an Event card?
span: Each player makes their own choice and acts once in any order.

question: What is the manufacturer's suggested retail price for this game?
Which retailer had exclusive promo cards for this game's original Kickstarter campaign?
Which decks are we supposed to leave unshuffled during setup?
span: Shuffle each deck except Summons, Daze [Daze], and Status [Status Green]/[Status Red], then place them in separate piles.

question: Do we heal up between Acts, or carry our damage forward?
span: All players heal to their maximum HP at the start of Act II and later Acts.

question: Do we set up a 1st Encounter deck again when we start Act II?
span: Note: Only Act I has a "1st Encounter" deck.

question: If one of us drops to zero health, can the others finish the fight and still win?
span: When a player's HP is reduced to 0, they are dead and the party loses the game.

question: We're using The Last Stand and one player died to the boss — can we move on to the next Act?
span: If a player died, you cannot continue to the next Act.

question: Who do enemies attack when the player in their row has died?
span: Enemies in a row with a dead player target the nearest row with a player below them.

question: How many potions can I carry at once?
span: You can't have more than 3 potions.

question: I'm holding the max number of potions and just found another one — what can I do?
span: If you gain a potion but you're at the limit, you must either: skip the potion, pass the potion to a player who is below their potion limit, or discard or use a potion then gain the new potion.

question: How many Boss relics do we lay out for a three-player game?
span: Reveal 1 Boss relic per player + 1.

question: Can I check what the upgraded version of a card does before deciding whether to take it?
span: You can always look at what an upgrade does before choosing.

question: Can I take two of the three revealed cards if I skip my next card reward?
span: You may add one revealed card to your deck or skip adding a card.

question: What happens to the two cards I didn't take from a card reward?
span: Return any unselected cards to the bottom of your card rewards deck.

question: A Golden Ticket just came up — where does the extra card come from?
span: Whenever you reveal a Golden Ticket, reveal the top card of your rare rewards deck and add that to your choices.

question: When I Transform a card, do I get to choose what I get back?
span: Add the top card of your card rewards to your deck (it should be random).

question: At a campfire, can I heal and upgrade a card in the same visit?
span: Each player chooses one of two actions, Rest or Smith:

question: How much HP does resting at a campfire give back?
span: Rest - Heal 3 HP.

question: At a treasure room, does everyone get a relic or just one player?
span: Each player gains a relic [Relic].

question: What does a rare card cost to buy from the merchant?
span: Gray banner cards are common [2 Gold], blue banners are uncommon [3 Gold], yellow banners are rare [6 Gold].

question: This monster has 14 HP but the track only goes to 10 — how do we track that?
span: Some monsters have more than 10 HP. Use 2 cubes.

question: Which row does the Elite go in?
span: Place one Elite in the bottom row.

question: Is the Boss only in one player's row?
span: Bosses are treated as being in all rows.

question: The enemy's action says it gains Block — does that Block land on me?
span: When an enemy gains Strength [Strength] or Block [Block], it always goes on the enemy, never on you.

question: Can I send the two hits of Twin Strike at two different enemies?
span: All [hit] on a multi-hit have the same target (unless stated otherwise).

question: If I hit a Vulnerable enemy with a two-hit attack, does it lose two Vulnerable tokens?
span: Remove one [Weak]/[Vulnerable] token when the entire multi-hit is complete.

question: Against a Vulnerable target, do I add my Strength bonus before or after the damage doubles?
span: Add damage bonuses like Strength [Strength] before doubling.

question: A Weak enemy is attacking a player who's Vulnerable — do those two cancel each other out?
span: If a Weak [Weak] target attacks a Vulnerable [Vulnerable] target, the attack is unaffected by both Weak [Weak] and Vulnerable [Vulnerable].

question: If I aim a row attack at the top row, does it still hit the Boss sitting off to the side?
span: Effects with the [Area of Effect] icon or that say "any row" target all enemies in a single row. They also always affect the Boss.

question: Can I attack a monster that's sitting in someone else's row?
span: Players can target any enemy.

question: Can The Guardian use its Attack Mode actions while it's in Defensive Mode?
span: The enemy can only use actions and abilities from the mode it is currently in.

question: Can I Scry 3 if there are only 2 cards left in my draw pile?
span: You can't Scry more cards than are in your draw pile.

question: After Scrying, can I rearrange the cards I decide to keep on top?
span: Then put any remaining cards back on top of your deck in the same order.

question: A Status card shows two different effects — do I resolve both of them?
span: Status cards use the top or bottom effect, whichever icon is on the enemy that gave it to you. The other effect is ignored that combat.

question: Does an Unplayable card still have an Energy cost I could pay?
span: Cards with "Unplayable" cannot be played and do not have an Energy cost.

question: A card's wording contradicts what the rulebook says — which one do we follow?
span: Whenever a card's text contradicts the rules, the card text takes precedence.

question: Do we keep our upgraded cards and relics for the next game?
span: You don't keep any upgrades, tokens, or items between games.

question: On Ascension 4, how many potions am I allowed to hold?
span: You're limited to 2 potions (instead of 3).

question: On Ascension 6, do we still heal to full at the start of Act II?
span: You heal 4 HP instead of to full HP at the start of Acts II & later.

question: How do we earn the Ruby Key?
span: All players must simultaneously take no action at a [Campfire] room (can't Rest or Smith).

question: Can I swap into another player's row partway through a fight?
span: Players may switch rows anytime between now and before the next combat room.

question: How much damage does Bludgeon deal?
span: Bludgeon (3) [Attack] — [dmg 7].

question: What does the Omamori relic do?
span: Omamori (5g) — You can't gain Curses.

question: Am I allowed to look through my discard pile during a fight?
span: After you play a card, it goes to your discard pile.

question: Can I count how many cards are left in my draw pile?
span: Shuffle your deck before combat begins to create your draw pile.

question: I misread a card and already played it — can I take it back?
span: While the card is being played, it isn't in your hand or in your discard pile.

question: Can two of us play the same character in the same game?
span: Each player chooses a character and takes the corresponding player board, mini, starter deck, card rewards deck, and rare rewards deck.

question: Can I choose to take the damage and hang onto my Block instead of spending it?
span: Prevent the next 1 damage to a player or enemy for each point of Block they have.

question: Is there a time limit on how long a player can take deciding their turn?
span: Players can play cards, use potions, and activate abilities in any order they choose.

question: If a teammate asks, am I required to tell them exactly which cards are in my hand?
span: as well as to ask questions like, "How much damage do you have?" or "Do you have enough Block?" rather than look at a player's hand.

question: When playing solo, do I run two characters or just one?
span: If you're playing solo, also gain [2 Gold] and the "Loaded Die" solo relic.

question: Can I go back and pick up a relic I skipped earlier in the run?
span: When relics are discarded or skipped, put them on the bottom of the relic deck.
